text:
I closed my door to the world;

my flesh was lost to me through dream...

I remained inward, magical, invisible,

naked as a blind man.


Filled to the very rim of my eyes,

I lit myself from within.


Trembling, transparent,

I remained upon the wind,

like a clean glass

of pure water,

like an angel of glass

in a mirror.

translation.title: I Closed My Door to the World
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the inward illumination and the glasslike vulnerability of the closing image.
